nodes.label: DICOM Patient Study Series Instance Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Preserves clinical identity and interoperable DICOM data modeling.
nodes.norm_label: dicom patient study series instance hierarchy

nodes.label: DICOM UID Identity
nodes.rationale: Study, Series, and SOP Instance UIDs are immutable identities supplied by acquisition or archive; only genuinely new DICOM objects require a registered-root generator.

nodes.label: PatientID with IssuerOfPatientID
nodes.rationale: PatientID is only unique within its issuer domain.

nodes.label: Pixel Data Preservation
nodes.rationale: Avoid unnecessary re-encoding or lossy transcoding because diagnostic information can be irreversibly lost.

nodes.label: Domain Pack Wrappers
nodes.rationale: Agent definitions retain roles and boundaries while canonical domain knowledge remains in portable packs.

nodes.label: Shared Realm Audience
nodes.rationale: A single realm lets tokens issued for the BFF carry the Archive audience and preserve user attribution in DICOM audit trails.

nodes.label: Problem catalog
nodes.rationale: The catalog is the canonical source for error contracts and generated artifacts.

nodes.label: Problem catalog code generation
nodes.rationale: Node tooling deterministically generates Java, TypeScript, lock, and human-readable catalog artifacts from the canonical registry.

nodes.label: W3C TraceID propagation
nodes.rationale: The plan accepts only W3C traceparent as the canonical incoming trace context and propagates it to DICOMweb.

nodes.label: DICOM domain reviewer gate
nodes.rationale: DICOMweb adapter and validation changes require review before the Phase 3 gate.

nodes.label: Problem catalog
nodes.rationale: A machine-readable catalog is shared by Java, TypeScript, documentation, and agents.

nodes.label: W3C TraceID propagation
nodes.rationale: Only W3C traceparent is the canonical incoming trace context; client-provided X-Trace-ID is not trusted.

nodes.label: Problem catalog skill
nodes.rationale: Thin agent wrappers apply the canonical Domain Pack and stop when an approval gate is absent.

nodes.label: DICOM domain review
nodes.rationale: Changes to DICOMweb adapters require DICOM review before the domain gate.
